title: qPCR based reporter assay on luciferase transcripts
protocol: Remove medium completely from adherent cells.
Wash cells carefully with 8 ml of 1xPBS, then remove PBS completely.
Add 8 ml of 1xTrypsin to cover the plate completely.
Incubate cells at 37°C until they detach completely.
Add 12 ml of Medium to the cells, resuspend and collect them in a 15 ml or 50 ml Falcon tube based on the number of EPOs required.
Count cells and aliquot 5x10^6 cells per electroporation.
Spin cells down at 125 g for 5 minutes.
Wash pellet once with 5 ml of Electroporation buffer.
Remove buffer, add approximately 50% of the final volume of EPO buffer to reach a total of 100 µl.
Prepare a separate tube with a mix of Renilla and pBluescript plasmids in a 1:10 ratio to achieve a total of 20 µg (Renilla 2 µg : pbluescript 18 µg).
Resuspend cells and add them to the DNA mixture carefully, avoiding air bubbles.
For control samples, do not add DNA to the cells.
Measure the volume of cells after adding plasmid DNA.
Fill up to a total volume of 100 μl with EPO buffer.
Add 100 µl of cell suspension into a 1x OC100 MaxCyte cuvette and use default settings for electroporation or optimization protocols as needed.
Transfer the 100 µl of cell suspension immediately to a pre-warmed 1x75 flask without adding medium.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Add an appropriate amount of pre-warmed medium without antibiotics to resuspend and plate cells at 1x10^6 cells per well in a pre-warmed 6-well plate.
For cells inducing interferon signaling upon DNA transfection, add C16 and BX-795 to the medium to a final concentration of 1 µM each inhibitor.
Harvest the cells 6 hours after adding media.
Harvest the medium from each well in a 15ml Falcon tube.
Wash once with 1 ml PBS and harvest the PBS.
Add 1 ml of trypsin and incubate at 37°C until cells fully detach; then add 1 ml of pre-warmed medium.
Harvest the cell suspension and spin down the cells at 125g for 5 minutes, removing the supernatant (S/N).
Resuspend cells in 1ml PBS.
Spin down cells again at 125g/5min, remove S/N.
Resuspend the cells in 350 μl RLT + 1% β-Mercaptoethanol.
Transfer lysate to Qiashredder column and spin for 2 min at max speed.
Discard column, mix flow through with 1 volume of 70% ethanol by pipetting.
Transfer up to 700 µl of lysate to RNeasy mini column and spin for 30s at 10,000g.
Discard flow through.
Wash column with 700 μl RW1 and spin for 30s at 10,000g; discard flow through.
Wash column with 500 µl RPE and spin for 30s at 10,000g; discard flow through.
Wash column with 500 μl RPE and spin for 2 min at full speed.
Place column into new collection tube and spin for 1 min at full speed.
Elute RNA into a new 1.5 ml tube with 50 µl RNase free H2O.
Add 2 µg of RNA sample, 2 µl of 10X Turbo DNase Buffer, and 2 µl of Turbo-DNase to an RNase-free tube on ice; fill up with H2O to 20 µl.
Incubate the tube at 37°C for 30 min.
Add 2 µl of inactivation solution to the reaction mixture after mixing well, and incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 10,000xg for 5 min; transfer 10 µl of RNA into a fresh tube for reverse transcription.
Transfer remaining 10 µl RNA into a separate tube as a negative –RT control.
Add 1 μl of Oligo dT20 (50 µM) and 1 µl of dNTPs (10 mM each) to the DNaseI treated RNA.
Mix 4 μl of 5X First-Strand Buffer, 1 μl of 0.1 M DTT, 1 μl of RNase Inhibitor Murine, and 1 μl of SuperScript III RT.
Add 1 μl H2O to the mixture and gently pipette up and down.
Incubate the reaction mix at 25°C for 5 minutes.
Incubate the reaction mix at 50°C for 50 minutes.
Incubate the reaction mix at 70°C for 15 minutes.
Bring the RT reaction volume to 100 μl by adding 80 μl H2O.
Mix 10 μl of GoTag SYBR Green Master Mix (2x), 1 μl primer mix, and 2 μl cDNA in a microcentrifuge tube.
Add 7 μl H2O to the mixture and gently pipette up and down.
Distribute 18 μl of the master mix into wells.
Add 2 μl of cDNA to each well containing the master mix.
Seal the reaction plate, vortex it, and spin it down.
Pipette each sample per primer pair in triplicate.
Incubate samples at 95°C for 2 minutes.
Cycle through 40 cycles: Incubate at 95°C for 3 seconds, then at 60°C for 30 seconds. Read the plate during the incubation at 60°C.
Normalize Firefly Ct values to Renilla Ct values using the delta Ct method described in Livak and Schmittgen (2001).
Calculate Delta delta Ct values between candidates.
